executive_verdict.summary: The computational framework of Komi et al. (2026) has been genuinely and faithfully transferred onto the biological and anatomical organization of Yakovenko et al. (2002). All 8 core computational engines (3D spatial embedding, anisotropic Gaussian kernels, row-wise E/I balancing, Forward Euler leaky rate integration with compound tanh, SVD/PCA phase unfolding, 1D net projectome convolution, traveling wave analysis, and decoupled gain sweeps) were implemented from mathematical first principles without hardcoded shortcuts.

numerical_ei_balance_audit.comparison_with_original_komi: Mathematically and algorithmically identical. Exactly as in BergLab BalanceConnectivity.m, only rows containing both E and I inputs can be zero-sum scaled (which achieve machine precision < 1e-15); boundary neurons receiving purely excitatory or purely inhibitory inputs retain single-sign inputs.
